input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

doc_friction.issue: huggingface.co and zenodo.org both answered 403 to CONNECT at 18:20 UTC (6a's run saw the same at 13:25 and success at 17:07); the programme's measured-data steps are hostage to proxy policy, and nothing says which hosts are flaky versus blocked

--for-changes on a research+post diff selects 9 workflows and hands off portfolio-pages' long site-builder tests after 100 s; for a research-only change the research-ci workflow is the one that matters, and it is hard to see from the output whether it ran

deviations.why: 6a's Next asked to price the time with the loader's fuel rates as swept stand-ins; with no excavator fuel signal and the data host blocked, a borrowed rate would answer little
deviations.did: computed the break-even rest-of-machine fuel rate instead, from committed results only, via a new identity (time ratio as a function of volume ratio) and a convexity bracket; the loader rates are reported as reference points
deviations.result: a single decision threshold (2.46 L/h central, 1.16 to 5.24 swept) that a builder can compare with one engine figure; 4 of 5 registered predictions held

notes: Local checks: heavy-hydraulics pytest 52 passed; paper/check_numbers.py 200 claims, 0 missing; research/_homepage/build.py ok; research_live_links --write; check_md_links ok; cite_check ok; post frontmatter/links/similarity ok. The geometry sweep (384 cases) could not be rerun for 6b without the raw data; it is listed as Next (b).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: derive identity, bracket script, tests, paper section and post for one research step

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
